description: This PHP source file appears to be a test script for Jira SOAP interface integration within the TestLink project. It constructs various XML payloads for custom fields, configures connection settings, and tests the connection to Jira's SOAP API, including creating an issue.

classes.name: jirasoapInterface
classes.description: A class that provides methods to connect to Jira's SOAP API and perform operations like adding issues.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the SOAP connection to Jira is established successfully.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Jira with specified summary and description.
